[http://www.zyxel.com/us/en/products_services/ac240.shtml Product page] This device is clearly an [[Edimax EW-7822UAC]]. :The FCC ID of the EW-7822UAC has been assigned to this entry. A 0586:3426 USB ID ''may'' be used for this device.. When viewing the USB connection information for this device it will show as being a USB2.0 device. Only when the wireless connects at the full speed of 802.11ac will the unit switch to USB3.0. ==Additional external links== ===Reviews + etc=== *[http://www.overclockers.com/wp-content/uploads/2013/09/zyxel-37.jpg Shown @ '''Overclockers.com'''] ===Vendors=== *[http://www.newegg.com/Product/Product.aspx?Item=N82E16833181289 On Newegg]
